relationships.subject: trigeminal ganglion
relationships.evidence_quote: Nociceptive neurons innervating intracranial blood vessels project via the ophthalmic division (V1) to the trigeminal ganglion and store several neurotransmitters including glutamate, substance P and calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP).

key_findings: Intracranial nociception is mainly mediated by the trigeminal system; convergence in the trigemino-cervical complex may explain headache features.
